subject: Exec intro + compact demo: aligning VP/CIO attendance windows
messages:
From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@skylake.io>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Barker <tbarker@novaholdings.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec intro + compact demo: aligning VP/CIO attendance windows

Thanks — we have a tight exec calendar. High level: CIO Amelia and VP Eng Marcus want a 20–25 minute executive intro (business outcomes + security posture) followed by a 30 minute hands-on demo for the platform team. Ideally both segments on the same day, back-to-back.

Two constraints: Amelia is only available 09/03 between 10:00–11:00 PT; Marcus can do 11:30–12:30 PT. Can you propose a plan to (a) cover the exec intro with Amelia, and (b) ensure someone from Redwood covers Marcus' window if it can't be contiguous? Also need an on-call backup if Amelia has to jump.

Appreciate a short agenda and calendar invite.

--
Elena
Head of Platform Partnerships
Skylake Analytics
From: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@skylake.io>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-02T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec intro + compact demo: aligning VP/CIO attendance windows

Elena — thanks for the windows and the clear ask. Quick proposal below so we can lock times: 

Plan A (preferred, single-day stitching):
- 10:00–10:25 PT — Exec intro with Amelia (So specifically focused on outcomes, security summary, and success metrics) — Soojin + Rishi (Rishi can take the security section).
- 10:30–11:00 PT — Compact technical demo for Marcus (engineer-facing) — Karthik leads; we keep it 30 minutes focused on integration and latency/cost slides.

This leaves a 5-minute buffer between sessions; Marcus can join at 10:30 if he can shift earlier by 60 minutes. If Marcus cannot shift, Plan B below handles coverage.

Plan B (parallel coverage / handoff):
- 10:00–10:25 PT — Exec intro with Amelia (soojin + rishi).
- 11:30–12:00 PT — Technical demo for Marcus (karthik).
- If Marcus can’t move earlier, we’ll record the exec intro and provide a 10-minute recap to him. We’ll also provide a 1-page summary of security posture and SLAs.

Attachments: agenda (PDF) and mutual action plan (xlsx) attached. I’m copying Rishi and Karthik to confirm coverage and backup. If this works I’ll send calendar invites for Plan A and mark Plan B as a fallback.

Shall I lock Plan A for 09/03 at 10:00 PT and invite Amelia and Marcus with a note about the 5-minute buffer?

Thanks,
Soojin
Senior Solutions Engineer\Redwood Inference
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai, Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@skylake.io>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-02T16:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec intro + compact demo: aligning VP/CIO attendance windows

Works for me — I can cover the security/controls portion at 10:00 and stay until 10:30 to support the handoff. Karthik: can you confirm you can lead the 10:30 technical demo (short deep dive + integration checklist)? If not, I can cover the first 10 minutes of the demo and then handoff.

Also, if Amelia needs to drop, I’ll remain as the backup to handle questions about SOC2/HIPAA and data residency.

-Rishi
Director, Security & Trust\Redwood Inference
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai, Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@skylake.io>
Date: 2026-09-02T17:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec intro + compact demo: aligning VP/CIO attendance windows

I’m good to lead 10:30–11:00 PT technical demo. I’ll prepare:
- 5m quick load/latency benchmarks relevant to Skylake
- 10m integration walkthrough (SDK/streams + security knobs)
- 10m Q&A + next steps (MVP integration plan)

Will use the mutual-action-plan items as the close. I’ve added a short tech runbook to the Drive folder and included the calendar invite draft as an ICS (attached).

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect\Redwood Inference
From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@skylake.io>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, Tom Barker <tbarker@novaholdings.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec intro + compact demo: aligning VP/CIO attendance windows

Thanks — Plan A looks good. Amelia confirmed she can do 10:00–11:00 PT if we keep the exec intro to 20 minutes. Marcus will try to slide to 10:30; if he can't, he’ll join for the 11:30 slot and Karthik will run the demo. 

Please send the invite marked "Plan A (preferred)" and include the short agenda and the recording note so Amelia’s EA can share the recording internally if needed. Also, add the mutual-action-plan to the invite so stakeholders have next steps.

Elena
--
Attachments referenced: redwood_exec_brief_agenda_v1.pdf (PDF), mutual-action-plan-skylake.xlsx (Excel), calendar-invite.ics (ICS stub)
